infra.share.title: Export · share
infra.share.audience.label: Template
infra.share.audience.hint.approval: For the approver: what runs · impact · duration · rollback, plus a diagram — NO command lines, NO ARNs, masking always on.
infra.share.audience.hint.runbook: For the operator: the full check · do · verify · rollback commands with resource ids. Internal use only.
infra.share.mask.buckets: Also mask bucket names and internal domains
infra.share.mask.enabledHint: Masks account ids · ARNs · endpoints and private IPs. You can turn it off, but a file leaving the machine usually wants it on.
infra.share.mask.warning: Masking is OFF — this copy still carries account ids, ARNs and internal endpoints.
infra.share.preview.title: Preview of what gets written
infra.share.preview.snapshot: Every export is a new snapshot: it writes a new file name and never overwrites the old one. The footer records when it was generated · the playbook version · the status at export time.
infra.share.done.copyFailed: Could not copy — select the text in the preview instead
infra.share.error.notFound: Nothing to export — it may have just been deleted.
infra.share.error.invalid: The source file is invalid, so no export could be built.
